body: Here in Burundi, the electricity has been more off than on lately, so I haven’t had a chance to blog about my experience here. We found electricity and an internet connection at a local restaurant … so here’s a slideshow from a gifted photographer about the Batwa people, with whom I spent last night and this morning. More later!
